capabilities.label: Wan VACE 14B
capabilities.notes: No image tool, native audio, lipsync, upscale, or native multi-shot. Reference images are not Kling element IDs.

capabilities.label: Wan 2.2 VACE
capabilities.notes: No image tool, native audio, lipsync, upscale, or native multi-shot. Reference images are not Kling element IDs.

capabilities.label: Vidu Q4 image to video
capabilities.notes: Native audio is implicit; no audio toggle, aspect ratio or end frame. Explicit-only hosted service. TODO review Vidu training/output terms. No speed SLA published.

capabilities.label: Vidu Q4 reference to video
capabilities.notes: Native audio is controlled by audio (default false); up to 12 images and 3 voice clips. Explicit-only hosted service. TODO review Vidu training/output terms. No speed SLA published.

capabilities.label: Seedance 1.5 Pro
capabilities.notes: No end frame, elements, native multi-shot, or editing controls in built schema.

capabilities.label: Seedream 5.0 Lite
capabilities.notes: Only 1K pricing confirmed. No 4K preset. Custom dimensions do not establish a supported maximum.

capabilities.label: Kling 3.0
capabilities.notes: Elements require existing provider library IDs. No video-to-video, lipsync or upscale tool. Elements only on i2v or Omni.

capabilities.label: Kling 3.0 Turbo
capabilities.notes: Turbo has no audio/end-frame/elements/4K controls and unconfirmed pricing.

capabilities.label: Kling 3.0 Omni
capabilities.notes: Elements require existing provider library IDs. No video-to-video, lipsync or upscale tool. Elements only on i2v or Omni.

capabilities.label: Runway Gen-4.5
capabilities.notes: Built ratios are 720-class only. No audio/end frame/multi-shot/elements controls.

capabilities.label: Runway Aleph
capabilities.notes: Faithful and multi-shot plate edits are routing preferences, not a native multi_shot control. Input max 1080p; output resolution is unspecified, so max_resolution=0. Single reference image, not element library.

capabilities.label: Runway Gen-4 Image
capabilities.notes: Turbo requires a source image. Reference image tags are not element library IDs.

capabilities.label: Runway Gen-4 Image Turbo
capabilities.notes: Turbo requires a source image. Reference image tags are not element library IDs.

capabilities.label: Luma Ray 3.2
capabilities.notes: Default standard generation uses Seedance/Kling; Luma is standard only for Modify, or explicit provider requests. i2v exactly 5s; no native audio/multi-shot/elements. No training/evaluation datasets under existing terms.
